status: SIMULATED rehearsal profile (owner delegation 2026-09-25). It is not the successor profile release-v7 needs, it is named by no product code and no gate, and it records NO established judge: every actor of the rehearsal is simulated and either is the repository-access session or shares the critic's provider family.

simulated_actors.simulated-author: one Claude Code session with full repository access (the session that also wrote the T077 dispatcher)
simulated_actors.simulated-reviewer: the same Claude Code session (repository access), not a second person
simulated_actors.simulated-sealer: the same Claude Code session (repository access)
simulated_actors.simulated-judge (offline run): a deterministic stub written by the same session; no provider answers it
simulated_actors.simulated-judge (live subset): the Claude judge (evals/deeptwin/verifiers/claude_judge.py) over the Claude API, the critic's own provider family, configured by the same session

judge_separation.requirement: The semantic judge must not share the critic's provider family or model: a named human reviewer judges every semantic item, or a judge from a different provider does, with identity, a non-null prompt digest and the exact judge model recorded. Under release-v7 a semantic status counts only when it is re-derived from the judge provider's raw response, the judge provider reported serving run_identity.judge_model with a request id, and the raw response is written to the trial's durable judge log; a judge that only declares its identity leaves every semantic item not_judged. Each trial is judged exactly once (audit 6, Y1): the judge log is created exclusively when judging starts and a trial whose judge log exists is never judged again; every judge request id is in the req_ form and distinct across the suite (audit 6, Y2), and the judge provider's judge-model requests in the run window must equal the logged request ids (post-verdict audit).
excluded_as_judge: any model or session with repository access, and any model of the critic's provider family or with the critic's model string (checked on the judge identity and the judge model with a provider/family alias table, case-insensitive substring matching; this guards only against accidental self-judging)

currently_available.consequence: judge separation is not established: semantic items and suites are at most not_judged

judge_attestation.other_provider: every judged item needs a durable raw judge response with the served model and request id the judge provider reported; the served model must equal run_identity.judge_model exactly; exactly one judging per trial, each request id distinct, and no judge-model request of the run window that is not in a judge log
judge_attestation.human_reviewer: no provider reports a human reviewer's identity; release-v7 has no attested human-reviewer path, so a human reviewer's answers leave the semantic items not_judged (open item in the design)

v3_error_independence.why: release-v7, like release-v3 to v6, has no generation path, so the item-level linking of generation-path errors and critic errors that verification.md section 6 requires cannot be observed; the tolerated joint-failure level and required precision are also not set by the owner. The verifier derives unverified for every release-v7 suite record from this design, never from the caller or the record.

fixed_now.task_and_error_scope: Q01-family critic judgments on design candidates: criteria Q1-Q8 and the six boundary classes
fixed_now.comparison_baseline: the same critic configuration with the empty lens pack (no_lens)
fixed_now.joint_error_definition: an item where the generation path's output has the defect and the critic misses it on the same item, and, separately, an item without the defect that the critic rejects; the two never share a denominator
known_confounders: shared model and training data between generator and critic
materials authored in one project style
fixed_now.analysis: descriptive counts with real denominators; a confidence interval only when its sample and dependence assumptions hold, otherwise counts and limits only

v3_error_independence.stop_and_exclusion: exclusions only before the first dispatch, with the reason recorded; after the first dispatch a disputed case makes the suite incomplete

metric_labels.joint_error: a generation-path defect missed by the critic on the same item (a V3 metric; needs a generation path, which release-v7 does not have)
metric_labels.judge_disagreement: a judge verdict differing from the sealed expectation (reported, never a joint error)

v3_error_independence.becomes_verified: only under a later frozen design that has a generation path, fixes the owner-set tolerated joint-failure level, sample size and precision, binds criticism verdicts to the critic configuration digest, is declared in the product gate's V3_VERIFYING_DESIGN_IDS after an independent audit, and has a run that meets it

not_claimed: a universal independence threshold or score
that a separate judge makes errors statistically independent
that any simulated actor is independent
a release qualification or scoped pass of any kind
